description: Expansion of National Measurement Laboratory of the Department of Measurement Units, Standards and Services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-31
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Johnston Fernando, Minister of Co-operatives and Internal Trade, to award the above tender to the lowest responsive bidder for a cost of Rs.1,328,457, 615.43, as recommended by the  Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.
